messages.text:
I can’t include the delivery charge in the item refund or label it as the item’s price; shipping is not part of the refund amount (refund-policy/v2/amount), and shipping charges are never refunded automatically (refund-policy/v2/shipping).

I’ve proposed **BRL 119.00** for the returned metal rack. You can confirm that exact proposal with the button on its card; a chat message won’t confirm it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
